properties.name: Newfoundland and Labrador shelf study area
properties.description: Hand-defined research polygon covering the Labrador coastal corridor, Northeast Newfoundland Shelf and Grand Banks. Not a provincial boundary, EEZ, navigation chart or C-CORE operational area. Land and coastal buffers are excluded separately. Analysis is clipped at pixel centres.
properties.source: CryoLens study design, 2026-09-05; not an authoritative boundary
